desc: Ideation complete: choose suffix DP with greedy reconstruction.
Define the DP state, indexing, INF value, and base cases; return an empty string immediately when n < 3 or when the minimum cost remains unreachable.
Implement the backward DP transitions: continuing the current run, switching only when the current run length is at least 3, and using best/second-best minima over letters to avoid O(26^2) work.
Store compact decisions for length-3 states to support reconstruction.
Compute the overall minimum cost by trying all possible first characters and selecting the smallest one that achieves the optimum.
Reconstruct the answer left to right using stored decisions, forcing continuation for run lengths 1 and 2.
Validate the current solution on sample tests and edge cases, including impossible short inputs, all-equal strings, multiple optimal run lengths, and lexicographic tie-breaking.
If validation fails, debug the failing case and adjust the DP/tie-breaking or switch to a full forward DP decision approach.
